properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/an_open_breach_reaches_the_loop.rs. Pins: an open defect finding on a Component, a Constraint or the Project is a counted next line and one open_breach gap, and a design holding one is not clean; a non-defect finding is not counted; valid_to closes it; a decision resting on it does not close it and INVALIDATES from that decision does; a ruling on its gap takes it out; a finding defect_overtaken_by_change asks about is asked once and stays in the loop; a non-KPP exceeded limit is a breach until its readings fit, and a ruling takes it out; an exceeded KPP keeps kpp_breached and is not asked twice; a VIOLATES edge into a Constraint is a breach until removed; a rule violation reads open_violation untriaged, open_breach once ruled must-fix, and nothing once resolved_at is recorded; a waiver is not a breach.
properties.findings: Observed failing first twice: the defect-finding tests on main 61c05ad74 (4c22a149a; 4 of 6 failed, the 2 asserting a closed finding stays out passed vacuously), and the renamed reading plus the three other kinds on 66a8ea279 (930a6c489; with the each tests, 16 of 21 failed, 5 vacuous). All pass after 05ac6178f and after merging main 9cb658c4b.
properties.name: Every recorded breach still standing reaches the loop until closed (12 tests)
